recipe:
* Region 2.4 x 2.4 um transverse and 2.4 um along the propagation axis d
  (z in 3D, y in 2D), mesh 0.1 um, 3 PML cells, 12 steps, Yee material
  sampling, staircase interfaces. ``graded`` refines the mesh around the
  structure (mesh_max 0.2 um, 6 points per wavelength); ``explicit`` freezes
  those graded nodes as fixed coordinates.
* The material sits in one block of 0.45 x 0.45 x 0.45 um at the centre; mode
  scenes (mode source or mode-port monitor) stretch it into a straight guide
  along d instead.
  ``dielectric`` is a constant index 2; ``dispersive_ade`` a two-pole
  Drude/Lorentz multipole material; ``anisotropic_tensor`` a symmetric tensor
  material; ``tensor_ade`` the same tensor material whose Lorentz pole is
  passed to the tensor-ADE API as explicit pole tensors; ``pec`` an ideal
  conductor material, which the schema does not offer.
* The boundary kind applies to every active face. Directional scenes (sheet,
  one-way, TFSF, mode and tiled-sheet sources, plane, mode-port and
  radiation-box monitors, tiled execution) carry CPML on the two d faces and
  the boundary kind on the transverse faces. CPML faces use alpha = 0 so that the PMC
  endpoint profile contract can accept them. Bloch faces carry a phase of
  0.3 rad on their axis.
* Sources are Gaussian, 1 um carrier, two cycles. ``point`` is an Ez point
  source; ``sheet`` a soft plane through the interior; ``plane_oneway`` a
  one-way plane over the whole transverse cell; ``tfsf`` a 0.8 um box;
  ``mode`` the soft plane template of a fixed-eigenmode launch;
  ``tiled_sheet`` a soft plane extended through the lateral PML.
* Monitors: ``point`` one Ez probe; ``plane_dft`` one d-normal frequency plane
  over the transverse interior (one cell short of PEC/PMC walls);
  ``mode_port`` two opposing fixed mode ports (no project monitors);
  ``radiation_box`` six frequency planes on a closed 0.8 um box, projected
  to the far field after the run.
* ``precision`` is Region.precision; ``cpu`` is backend cpu, ``cuda_torch`` is
  backend cuda with the Torch kernels, ``cuda_fused`` backend cuda with the
  fused CuPy kernels.

rules.name: mode_source_unavailable
rules.message: The Project schema offers point, plane and TFSF sources; fixed-eigenmode launches exist only as inputs of ModeInjectedPlaneSimulation and ModeNetwork.

rules.name: mode_port_unavailable
rules.message: The Project schema offers point and field monitors; mode ports exist only as ModeNetwork inputs.

rules.name: tensor_ade_unavailable
rules.message: The Project schema offers no tensor ADE material; tensor poles exist only as TensorDispersiveSimulation inputs.

rules.name: tensor_ade_streamed_unavailable
rules.message: The streamed tensor path takes node tensors only; it has no pole inputs.

rules.name: material_pec_schema
rules.message: Input should be 'dielectric', 'tensor', 'drude', 'lorentz' or 'multipole'
rules.note: No ideal-conductor material model exists; PEC enters as a boundary face only.

rules.message: Native tensor materials require FP32 material on uniform 3D grids.

rules.message: Tiling requires a uniform mesh with one spacing on every axis.

rules.name: tiled_faces

rules.name: tiled_sheet_span

rules.name: tiled_monitor

rules.name: radiation_box_faces

rules.note: Checked after the run on the stored planes; the differentiable project_farfield accepts any six planes.

rules.name: radiation_box_sheet_support
rules.message: Total-field source support must be enclosed and clear of the measurement faces.
rules.note: A soft sheet outside the box is a total-field source; the closed-box transform needs it enclosed.

rules.name: radiation_box_tfsf_support

lanes.name: forward.mode_network
lanes.description: Two-port complex S matrix of the fixed mode ports without gradients (prepare_modal_launch for periodic/Bloch transverse faces, prepare_open_modal_launch for CPML).

lanes.name: forward.modal_planes
lanes.description: Fixed-eigenmode sheet launch with spectral plane observers, no gradient.

lanes.name: forward.tensor_ade
lanes.description: Full-tensor trapezoidal ADE on node tensors, no gradient.

lanes.name: forward.tensor
lanes.description: Native tensor solver dispatched by Simulation.run (Torch operations).
lanes.note: cuda_kernel="fused" is not honoured: the summary warns that tensor execution uses Torch operations.

lanes.name: forward.endpoint
lanes.description: Exact-endpoint PEC/PMC/CPML solver dispatched by Simulation.run.

lanes.name: forward.grid
lanes.description: Native Yee/CPML forward on the fdtd grid; radiation boxes project the stored planes through native_radiation_box.

lanes.name: checkpointed.mode_network
lanes.description: Interior material VJP of the two-port S matrix.

lanes.name: checkpointed.modal_planes
lanes.description: Checkpointed adjoint through the fixed modal sheets.

lanes.name: checkpointed.tensor_ade
lanes.description: Checkpointed derivatives of node epsilon_inf and tensor poles.

lanes.name: checkpointed.tensor
lanes.description: Project-rasterized node tensors through TensorDielectricSimulation with the fixed isotropic CPML collar.

lanes.name: checkpointed.dispersive_planes
lanes.description: ADE material VJPs of spectral planes; radiation boxes project through project_farfield.

lanes.name: checkpointed.dispersive
lanes.description: Checkpointed derivatives of epsilon_inf and the passive poles.

lanes.name: checkpointed.planes
lanes.description: Checkpointed adjoint of fixed spectral planes; radiation boxes project through project_farfield.

lanes.name: checkpointed.point
lanes.description: Discrete Yee/CPML adjoint with bounded checkpoints and point observations.

lanes.name: streamed.modal_planes
lanes.description: Streamed X-slab execution of the fixed modal sheets and plane observers.

lanes.name: streamed.tensor
lanes.description: Streamed node-tensor slabs with the geometric CPML criterion.

lanes.name: streamed.dispersive_planes
lanes.description: Streamed ADE slabs with spectral plane observers.

lanes.name: streamed.dispersive
lanes.description: Streamed ADE slabs with point observations.

lanes.name: streamed.planes
lanes.description: Streamed slabs with spectral plane observers.

lanes.name: streamed.point
lanes.description: Host or file-backed streamed slabs with point observations; the streamed execution mode runs it without gradient, the streamed adjoint with backward.

lanes.name: reversible.periodic
lanes.description: Lossless periodic reconstruction adjoint on a closed periodic cell.

lanes.name: reversible.cpml_planes
lanes.description: Recorded-interface CPML adjoint with spectral planes.

lanes.name: reversible.cpml
lanes.description: Recorded-interface CPML adjoint with point observations.

lanes.name: tensor_batch
lanes.description: One-case fused CUDA cohort; radiation boxes project the stored planes through native_radiation_box.
lanes.note: The cohort always runs the fused batch kernel; cuda_kernel="torch" is reported as fused_batch in the summary.

lanes.name: tiled
lanes.description: plan_tiles partitions the lateral extent; each tile runs Simulation.run and the output planes are stitched.

normal.description: No Bloch phase on a transverse axis: k_parallel = 0 at every frequency.

fixed_k_parallel.description: Bloch phase phi on a transverse axis of length L: k_parallel = phi / L is fixed and the angle asin(k_parallel / (n k0)) varies across the band; frequencies with k_parallel > n k0 are evanescent.

fixed_angle.message: Fixed-angle broadband injection is not implemented: a Bloch cell fixes k_parallel, so the incidence angle varies across the band (feature inventory source.angle and boundary.bfast are missing). Preview the fixed-k_parallel source instead.
